pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Creates a smoky decoy that draws enemy attention while you vanish from sight.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 15.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Enemies focus on the decoy, giving you time to reposition or escape. The smoky apparition is not a real fighter and will not defeat enemies for you.

pages.title: Stolen Appearance
pages.text: If you possess a creature and use Delirium inside it, the creature dies and you take its looks: your model changes for everyone.$(br2)Mobs treat you as that creature: zombies leave a zombie alone, a golem sees a monster as an enemy, and a villager draws zombies at once.$(br2)The look stays until you steal another. To put it on or take it off, $(thing)hold Delirium for 5 seconds$(). A short press remains the normal Delirium.
